information.description:
The closest thing to a corporate cyberninja that the streets can produce. Kunoichis are blurs of chrome that hunt down the toughest enemies the Tygers have, and are often considered the true apex predators of Japantown. While they don’t hit too hard, good luck catching up and landing a hit without getting bit.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Tyger Claws).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does ignore half armor.

The preferred pistol among Night City cops – light, wieldy, and easy on the recoil, it's perfect for taking down enemies without necessarily killing them on the spot. Thanks to its relatively small dimensions, the gun has also found a loyal following among those who prefer a concealed carry: the Lexington easily fits in a coat pocket or purse. And for design lovers, its classic 2030s frame remains stunning as ever.

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 21 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Pistol Autosear, Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: None.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

A dense, layered microplating that boosts the stopping power of cybernetic armor, giving extra bite against blunt force and ballistics.

Skinweave/Subdermal Armor Cyberware Enhancement. Increases the enhanced armor’s SP by 1. Cannot increase the SP of Dragoon Plating.

NOTE: Credit to the From the Ashes LC for the idea on changes to this item.

Enhances: Skinweave or Subdermal Armor
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo prices this by the armor's SP, so it comes as two items.
  • Change the SP on the armor item by hand; an upgrade installed in cyberware can't do it.

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2
